newsitem.title: USA: LPC-Fox Sports taps Chase, Toronto-Dominion.
newsitem.headline: LPC-Fox Sports taps Chase, Toronto-Dominion.

text.p: NEW YORK, April 22 (LPC) - Chase Manhattan and Toronto-Dominion next week will launch with a bank meeting a $575 million loan backing Fox Sports, market sources said.
The deal will mark Fox Sports' first syndicated loan.
Chase will act as administrative and syndication agent, while Toronto-Dominion will act as documentation agent, the sources added. The two firms will fully underwrite the loan.

The credit likely will be split between a $200 million to $275 million, 364-day reolving credit that converts to a seven-year term loan, and a $300 million to $375 million, seven-year reducing revolving credit, the sources said.
Pricing, which was not available, will not be leveraged, they added.
Fox Sports is part of News Corp.
